fields.description: Cala Del Mar is Ellington’s waterfront apartment development on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Curved balconies and shared fitness, play and pool spaces shape its coastal residential setting.

overview: Brief: one parking space for Studio–2BR; two for 3–4BR. AED 14/ft² is an anticipated service-charge estimate, not an approved current levy.
